title: Payoff Quotes, Overpayment Refunds and Kestrel Care Refund Credits — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Issuing a quote.** A payoff quote can be issued only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or in deficiency.

**Retired wording.** The following two clauses of the original payoff terms are no longer in force; they have been superseded by the current quote terms of the Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract:

- *No longer in force:* "The good-through date is the quote validity period, in calendar days, after the quote date unless the requester asks for an earlier date."
- *No longer in force:* "The per diem is the principal balance times the APR divided by the day basis, rounded to the cent, and the payoff amount is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus the per diem times the quote interest days."

**Paying against a quote.** Funds received on or before the good-through date in at least the quoted amount pay the contract in full; funds received later are applied as a payment and a new quote is needed.

**Third-party quotes.** A quote for a refinance lender, a dealer trade-in or an insurance total loss purpose is issued to that third party only with the customer's verified authorization on the call.

**Overpayment refunds.** An overpayment refund can be issued only when the contract status is paid in full or closed. A credit balance of at least the automatic-refund threshold left after the balance reaches zero is refunded to the payer by check within the overpayment refund days, in calendar days; a smaller credit balance is refunded only on request.

**Kestrel Care refund credits.** A cancellation refund from a financed Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract is credited to the principal balance and does not advance the next due date; when the contract is already paid in full or closed the refund is paid to the customer as an overpayment refund instead.

### Outcomes at a glance

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Funds of at least the quoted amount, received on the good-through date | contract paid in full |
| Same funds received the day after the good-through date | applied as a payment; a new quote is needed |
| Credit balance at or above the threshold after payoff | refunded by check, automatically |
| Credit balance below the threshold | refunded only on request |
| Care cancellation refund on an active contract | credited to principal; next due date unchanged |
| Care cancellation refund on a contract paid in full | paid to the customer as an overpayment refund |

superseded_clauses: The good-through date is payoff_quote_valid_days calendar days after the quote date unless the requester asks for an earlier date.

The per diem is the principal_balance times apr divided by per_diem_day_basis, rounded to the cent, and the payoff amount is principal_balance plus fees_due_balance plus the per diem times preowned_msr_quote_interest_days.
